Removal cost: lose {{gr|10|3}} Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.}} {{Skill progression |attribute = [[Critical Strikes]] |var1 name = [[Duration]] |var1 at0 = 3 |var1 at15 = 17 |var2 name = [[Energy]] loss |var2 at0 = 10 |var2 at15 = 3}} == Acquisition == '''[[Signet of Capture]]''' * [[Darkroot Entrop]] ([[Mourning Veil Falls]]) * [[Arius, Dark Apostle]] ([[Rhea's Crater]]) == Notes == * At rank 14 in [[Critical Strikes]] and using [[Critical Eye]], the energy loss can be negated (or alternatively at rank 13 with a [[zealous]] weapon). * The enchantment removal happens before you successfully hit with an attack, which can negate enchantments that react with attacks such as [[Reversal of Damage]] or [[Judge's Intervention]]. * Although [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] uses this skill, Dark Apostasy cannot be captured from it because it is not a boss. == Trivia == * [[w:Apostasy|Apostasy]] refers to the act of abandoning a set of religious beliefs. {{Skill change}} [[de:Dunkle Abtrünnigkeit]]
